_comment: Licensing configuration. Three values must be filled in before selling:
organizationId  - Polar dashboard > Settings > General > Organization ID.
This is not a secret; the validate/activate endpoints are
public and it identifies which organisation a key belongs to.
checkout.pro    - the Polar checkout link for the Pro product.
Then map each product's License Keys benefit id onto a tier below, so the app
can tell a Pro key from a Technician key. Benefit ids appear in the Polar
dashboard under the benefit, and in the validate response as 'benefit_id'.
IMPORTANT: leave benefitIds empty on ONE tier at most. A tier with no
benefit ids is the fallback for any valid key, so if both are empty every
key resolves to whichever comes first - which is how Technician customers
would silently get Pro. Fill Technician's in, or fill both.
